Build strength, improve flexibility, and create more balance in your body with this 20 min full body yoga flow.
For a course to help you develop your practice step by step, use this link to join the Transform Course on the CMC for 1 month free:
This daily yoga practice is designed to help you stretch tight muscles, build functional strength, improve mobility, and feel more energized in both body and mind. Whether you’re looking for a quick morning yoga routine, a full body stretch, or a short daily workout to stay consistent, this class will help you move, breathe, and reset.
